::: {#exr-sample}

#### Writing new lines

Draw 1,000 characters from the trained network of @sol-gru-lm with `sample(lm, "MENENIUS:\n", 1000)`.
What share of the drawn words occur somewhere in the training text?

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
def sample(net, prompt, n, temperature=1.0, seed=0):
    # Feeds `prompt`, then draws `n` characters one at a time,
    # feeding each one back in.
    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
    x = torch.tensor([[index[ch] for ch in prompt]])
    drawn = []
    net.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        logits, state = net(x)
        for _ in range(n):
            p = torch.softmax(logits[0, -1] / temperature, dim=0)
            nxt = torch.multinomial(p, 1, generator=generator)
            drawn.append(nxt.item())
            logits, state = net(nxt.view(1, 1), state)
    return prompt + decode(torch.tensor(drawn))


print(sample(make_lm(), "MENENIUS:\n", 40))
```

`sample()` draws each character from the network's distribution over the next character,
given the prompt and the characters drawn so far;
the untrained network above draws characters close to at random.

:::
